stem: The search platform credits its ads with 900 orders and the social platform credits its ads with 700. Voltmarkt's own order data shows 1,200 orders that touched either channel's ads. Together the two channels cost €48,000. Why is €48,000 / 1,600 = €30 too low as the CPA of the two channels together?

options.text: Some orders were claimed by both platforms, so 1,600 counts them twice
Returning customers' orders were counted, and a CPA must always leave them out
Store orders were left out, and they belong in every channel's CPA
The spend should be split by clicks before it is divided by orders
